requiredFindings.title: Discovery marker custody reports linkage/size before ACL refusal
requiredFindings.finding: check_project_object_waived passes an empty known ACL to super::check, which performs file link-count and size checks before the captured ACL is inspected. The bound SLM _file_custody checks the real ACL before link count and size. On combined failures, discover therefore emits different MARKER_CUSTODY reasons from its required reference, changing pending provenance and accepted boundary-inventory bytes.

examples.marker: owned regular package.json, mode 0644, nlink=2, aclWrite=[uid:4242], invoker 1000
owned regular package.json, mode 0644, nlink=2, aclUnreadable=true
owned regular package.json, mode 0644, nlink=1, size=4194305, aclWrite=[uid:4242]

requiredFindings.requiredChange: Provide the reference-equivalent discovery file judgment order: kind, owner, mode, actual ACL, then links and size. Preserve the accepted legacy check_project_object judgment rather than silently reordering its existing refusals. Add cross-implementation vectors and product controls for ACL-write and unreadable-ACL combined with hard links and oversize, including waiver cases showing markers remain unwaived; rerun the required evidence and regenerate pins.
